sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 4 = check 3; Internal Quality Checks row 4 annotation: 'author notes, TODOs, stray paths, contradictions')
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/tests/test.sh (launch env lines 104-109, 160-165) and tests/Dockerfile (lines 1, 20-21), only to cross-check stated runtime facts for contradictions
evidence: Read instruction.md (5 lines, 683 bytes) and all six note files (56 lines) in full. Spelling: extracted every distinct word from the brief and notes (about 600) and reviewed the list; no misspelling. British spelling is used consistently ('behaviour', 'colour', 'coloured', 'Colouring'); a search for color/behavior/center/gray/favor variants found none, so there is no mixed-dialect slip. No doubled words. Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|???|lorem and for drive-letter, /home/ or /Users/ paths over instruction.md, environment/instructions and environment/assets returned nothing; the template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' has been replaced. All files are plain ASCII with no CR and no trailing whitespace; no author asides, no duplicated paragraphs. Only container paths appear (/app, /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app/app.db, /app/node_modules), and they match environment/Dockerfile ('COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/'). Internal consistency: instruction.md:3 says 'Please read the six notes in /instructions' and exactly six note files exist; instruction.md:3 '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish' agrees with integration.md:7 ('contains no user snippets or starter implementation'), the seed ('"snippets": []') and the Dockerfile (/app holds only .gitkeep); 'serve the workspace at /' agrees with integration.md:3; 'without signing in' agrees with overview.md:3 and policy.md:3; one run budget value only ('five-second', behaviour.md:5), one refresh interval ('within about five seconds', behaviour.md:11), one port (3000), one database path rule (integration.md:9), one seed path. Stated runtime facts match the harness: tests/test.sh launches with PORT="3000", DB_PATH and NODE_PATH under env -i, and tests/Dockerfile uses node:22 with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1, as integration.md:5 says. Cross-references resolve (policy.md:3 -> ui.md, integration.md:5 -> security.md). Apparent tensions are explicit carve-outs, not contradictions: ui.md:3 bans an input as the document surface but allows 'A small input solely for keyboard or clipboard plumbing'; security.md:3 blocks network from the preview while 'The app itself may load public dependencies and assets' (matching integration.md:5). Evidence index: all 16 scripted-golden artifact hashes match raw bytes and all 6 hosted-run JSON hashes match LF-normalised bytes; none of that evidence bears on this row, which is a static text check, so no measurement is missing. Notes (not defects): (1) the input SHA256 of the frozen snapshot was not independently recomputed by me, only preserved; (2) check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py were not available to run, so the mechanical half was applied by hand as above.
